basic_details.job_title: Prasar Bharati Casual Broadcast Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Prasar Bharati has notified 1 vacancy for the Casual Broadcast Assistant post on a temporary basis for assignment at the Regional News Unit, Akashvani, Sambalpur. Eligible candidates must submit their offline application in the prescribed proforma 'Annexure-A' by Speed Post or Courier to The Head of Office, Akashvani, Kacheri Road, Sambalpur on or before 3 November 2026, along with the processing fee payment receipt and self-attested photocopies of certificates. application_fee.details: The application processing fee is non-refundable and must be deposited through a bank draft payable in favour of the Drawing & Disbursing Officer, All India Radio, Cuttack, or deposited directly into SBI Account No. 10861705257 (IFSC Code: SBIN0000059).

qualification.details: Essential Qualifications: | Graduate with a professional Diploma in Radio Production with three (03) years of experience. Proficiency in Odia, Hindi, and English. Knowledge of computer applications. Practical knowledge of audio editing and typing in Odia, English and Hindi. | Other Eligibility Conditions: Candidate must reside within the Sambalpur Municipal Corporation area.

selection_process: The selection procedure comprises two stages:
Written test on general knowledge and current affairs. Practical proficiency test in computer operations for various audio/video formats.
Candidates who secure 50% or above in the written examination will be eligible for the practical proficiency test in computer operations and audio/video editing.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential Qualifications: Graduate with a professional Diploma in Radio Production with three (03) years of experience. Proficiency in Odia, Hindi, and English. Knowledge of computer applications. Practical knowledge of audio editing and typing in Odia, English and Hindi. Other Eligibility Conditions: Candidate must reside within the Sambalpur Municipal Corporation area.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Prescribed application proforma 'Annexure-A' Processing fee payment receipt (bank draft payable in favour of Drawing & Disbursing Officer, All India Radio, Cuttack or SBI Account No. 10861705257, IFSC: SBIN0000059) Self-attested photocopies of educational and professional qualification certificates Self-attested photocopies of computer proficiency certificates Job experience certificates

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection procedure comprises two stages: Written test on general knowledge and current affairs. Practical proficiency test in computer operations for various audio/video formats. Candidates who secure 50% or above in the written examination will be eligible for the practical proficiency test in computer operations and audio/video editing.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for Prasar Bharati Casual Broadcast Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application is 03.11.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application processing fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application processing fee for General category candidates is Rs. 354/-.

faq.question: Q3. Where should candidates send their filled application forms?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their applications by Speed Post or Courier to The Head of Office, Akashvani, Kacheri Road, Sambalpur-768 001 (Odisha).

faq.question: Q4. What are the selection stages for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a written test on general knowledge and current affairs, followed by a practical proficiency test in computer operations and audio/video editing for candidates who secure 50% or above in the written exam.
